criterion_rationale: Engineering minimum for a capable metadata-informed instrument, not a statistical rejection threshold or estimate of main EX. Frozen before any candidate generation. Failures/truncation retained, never repaired.
main_results_use: Do not evaluate30main questions for selection. Prior600-trial main remains preserved and reported. Any subsequent main is a disclosed post-first-run replication, not retroactive model selection.
reasoning_handling: One API request; server separates reasoning_content from final message.content. Raw response including reasoning retained, final content evaluated as SQL. No DB/MCP/tool access, execution feedback or semantic repair.
reference_basis: AI-assisted A/B agreement with predeclared semantic witnesses before generation
selection_conditions: All96 outcomes evaluable; no unresolved infrastructure incident
All48 question/scenario contexts fit without truncation
S3 has>=1correct trial in each of3rule families
selection_rule: Use first candidate in declared order satisfying all conditions; test second only if first is infeasible or fails. Do not choose by largest metadata gap or p-value. No candidate if both fail.
